title: core+sector reversal signal as a causal gate on the model's real top-3 picks
notes: Gated beats baseline on both avg_pct and win_rate, on both TRAIN and VAL -- never flips sign, unlike everything else tested this session. But the VAL margin is small (+0.09pp avg / +0.23pp win) -- see sector_reversal_gate_bootstrap.py for the statistical significance check.

conclusion.summary: Never flips sign across train/val, but the bootstrap/permutation significance check (see sector_reversal_gate_bootstrap) confirms the validation-split edge is not distinguishable from noise (p=0.85).
